exposure: Oxytocin dose requirements (≤4 mU/min (low-dose-requiring) vs ≥20 mU/min (high-dose-requiring))
cohort: Term, nulliparous women requiring oxytocin for labor augmentation or induction (n=187)
finding: Obesity, diabetes, and labor induction were associated with the requirement for high doses of oxytocin.
mod_finding: High-dose-requiring women were more likely to undergo cesarean delivery for first-stage arrest and less likely to undergo cesarean delivery for nonreassuring fetal status.
